provider: Yandex Mail — 5 GB pooled with Disk, 1 GB attachment

free_tier.stated: Yandex's own docs: "By default, users without a plan get 5 GB of storage space." Mail and Disk now share one pool: "Emails and attachments in Yandex Mail now share storage with files on Yandex Disk." Attachment cap: "The maximum attachment size is 1 GB. You can add larger files to messages only if you have a Yandex 360 plan."

tooling: IMAP probe-verified: `imap.yandex.com:993` -> `* OK Yandex IMAP4rev1 at imap.yandex.ru:993 ready` / `* CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 CHILDREN UNSELECT LITERAL+ NAMESPACE XLIST UIDPLUS ENABLE ID AUTH=PLAIN AUTH=XOAUTH2 MOVE`. SMTP: `250-SIZE 53477376` = 51 MiB.
chaining: 5 GB × N accounts. The 1 GB attachment cap makes it look generous per message, but the pool is 5 GB, so one attachment is 20% of the account.
limits_note: per-object-cap 1 GB attachment (docs) but SMTP SIZE says 51 MiB — the 1 GB path is a Disk-upload link, not an SMTP attachment, so again link-vs-storage. Pool is 5 GB shared with Disk. Hard retention decay ladder documented: full -> attach >25 MB blocked; 44 days -> cannot send/read; 90 days -> **Disk may be cleared, files unrecoverable**.
